items.q: The transcript contains no response from the interviewee (Joe Thomas) regarding James P. Johnson. The mention of working for James P. Johnson is made by the [INTERVIEWER], not the interviewee.

ctx.x: I told him I didn't like uniforms ... so in the '40s I started to work for James P. Johnson.

items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] James P. Did you know, you know his work.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, then, let's see, with Joe Sullivan.

James P. Did you know, you know his work. He's a tremendous person. And, since we're talking about it, I've heard a lot of things happen, you know, and he's a tremendous musician and I've heard lot of things happen with the piano and different instruments. So, one night I think John was in there, John Hammond was in there that particular night and he made a request. Now, James' approach to music was wonderful.
